snippet.title: MycoRelic - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist MycoRelic on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2624080/MycoRelic/

You are a fungal robot, reborn on the beaches of a mysterious island.

Emerge from the lost and forgotten foundries of a failed civilization and explore the new growth of a blooming fungal world. Discover ancient ruins in varying biomes, each with their own tribal villages. Form alliances and face enemies, recovering the lost histories of the island’s inhabitants.

Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/JBFMec2JYU
